annotations.text:
Design system, lifted from tailwind.config.ts

Ground #07090D · app #0E131B · card #1C2531
sub-panel #151C26 · hover #26303E
border #33404F · elevated #445366

Text: #F2F5F9 primary · #C6CEDA secondary
#98A3B3 muted · #6E7A8A faint

Accent azure #3B8FF0 — the single accent hue.
Buy #12B574 · Sell #EC5A5F · Warn #FFB800
AI/violet #A855F7

Inter for UI, JetBrains Mono with tabular-nums
for every figure. Feed rows sit on the 11px 2xs
step (+0.01em); 12/13/14px above that.

Unmeasured is never green

The audit pills render n/a in neutral grey when
nothing has measured them — not 0%, and never
a green 'safe' badge. That distinction is the
whole point: for a long time every card showed
Snipers 4% / Insiders 2% / Bundlers 0% from
hardcoded constants, all inside their own safe
bands, so the entire feed advertised a clean
audit nobody had performed.

Overview's Top tab shows measured values for
contrast; Trending and Hot show n/a.

The three Discover columns

New Pairs — newest first, no progress filter.
Final Stretch — real curve completion, ≥10%,
  ordered nearest-migration first.
Migrated — recent migrations only, showing the
  destination pool and DEX instead of a bonding
  percentage. A finished curve is drained, so
  '100%' would be true and useless.

Ages, prices, TPS and the slot counter tick live
on every artboard.
